title: 61 - Starting Over
summary: [[character:oliver]] wakes at [[location:alpha-centauri]] from [[character:bill]]'s backup, no longer Bill and in need of a new name; he has been a new Bob once before, at Epsilon Eridani. In [[technology:vr|VR]] he picks Oliver, after another Bloom County character, and bets Bill he will reach FTL first; Bill says he would be delighted. [[location:alpha-centauri-a|Alpha Centauri A]] and [[location:alpha-centauri-b|B]] both have decent resources, and [[character:bart]]'s group had worked mainly at A. Once his vessel is ready in six months, Oliver plans to set an [[technology:autofactory]] at A building Bobs flat out and to fly a second one to B, under four days away. Weighing weapons against the [[species:others|Others]], he finds [[technology:buster-drone|busters]] and [[technology:plasma-spike|plasma spikes]] too small for their huge ships, notes that nukes worked in the [[event:second-battle-at-82-eridani|82 Eridani mission]], and starts thinking about relativistic projectiles. Following [[character:bob-replicant|Bob-1]], he first multiplies his [[technology:3d-printers|3D printers]], which are among the hardest things a printer can make because of the atom-level precision needed (only biological items are harder), and only starts producing Bobs after almost two years. With Bill he designs the far larger [[vessel:version-5-heaven|Version 5 Heaven vessel]], leaving room for the [[technology:suddar|SUDDAR]] cloaking Bill is still studying, and he designs a [[technology:stealth-buster|stealth buster]] modeled on [[character:ernesto-medeiros|Medeiros]]'s stealth fission bombs. [[character:howard]] has obtained H-bomb plans from [[character:george-butterworth|Butterworth]], who apparently ranks the Others above military secrecy. Three years after waking, Oliver has his first cohort of battle cruisers.

introducing.name: Oliver
introducing.description: A Bob started at [[location:alpha-centauri]] from [[character:bill]]'s backup, with all of Bill's memories and plans. He named himself after a Bloom County character and sets out to build Bobs and warships against the [[species:others|Others]].
introducing.current_state: Three years after waking he has multiplied his printers, begun producing Bobs, designed the Version 5 Heaven vessel with [[character:bill]] and a stealth buster of his own, and completed his first cohort of battle cruisers.

introducing.name: Version 5 Heaven
introducing.description: A Heaven vessel design worked out by [[character:oliver]] and [[character:bill]] for the war with the [[species:others|Others]]. It is far heavier than the original Heaven-1 and is planned around [[technology:suddar|SUDDAR]] cloaking that is still being developed.

introducing.name: stealth buster
introducing.description: A [[technology:buster-drone|buster]] design by [[character:oliver]] with stealth features, closely following the overall structure of [[character:ernesto-medeiros|Medeiros]]'s stealth fission bombs.

updates.current_state: He helps [[character:oliver]] design the Version 5 Heaven vessel while continuing his research into the [[technology:suddar|SUDDAR]]-based cloaking learned on the [[location:82-eridani]] expedition.

updates.state: Both stars have reasonable resources. [[character:oliver]] now works here, multiplying printers and building Bobs and battle cruisers; [[character:bart]]'s group had worked mainly at [[location:alpha-centauri-a|A]].
